title: Selective Inference for Time-Varying Moderated Effects
abstract: arXiv:2411.15908v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal effect moderation investigates how the effect of interventions (or treatments) on outcome variables changes based on observed characteristics of individuals, known as potential effect moderators. With advances in data collection, datasets containing many observed features as potential moderators have become increasingly common. High-dimensional analyses often lack interpretability, with important moderators masked by noise, while low-dimensional, marginal analyses yield many false positives due to strong correlations with true moderators. In this paper, we propose a two-step method for selective inference on time-varying causal effect moderation that addresses the limitations of both high-dimensional and marginal analyses. Our method first selects a relatively smaller, more interpretable model to estimate a linear causal effect moderation using a Gaussian randomization approach. We then condition on the selection event t

translated_title: 时变调节效应的选择性推断
translated_abstract: 因果效应调节研究的是干预（或处理）对结果变量的影响如何根据个体观察到的特征（即潜在效应调节变量）而变化。随着数据收集技术的进步，包含许多作为潜在调节变量的观测特征的数据集变得越来越普遍。高维分析通常缺乏可解释性，重要调节变量被噪声掩盖，而低维边际分析则由于与真实调节变量的强相关性而产生大量假阳性结果。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于时变因果效应调节的选择性推断的两步方法，该方法解决了高维分析和边际分析的局限性。我们的方法首先使用高斯随机化方法选择一个相对较小、更具可解释性的模型来估计线性因果效应调节，然后基于选择事件进行条件推断。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两步选择性推断方法，通过高斯随机化选择可解释模型并基于选择事件进行条件推断，从而在时变因果效应调节分析中同时克服高维分析的可解释性不足和边际分析的假阳性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step selective inference method that uses Gaussian randomization to select an interpretable model and conditions on the selection event, addressing both the interpretability issues of high-dimensional analysis and the false positive problems of marginal analysis in time-varying causal effect moderation.
